vb_textbox.text: Pick a gnome and stick with it until the scores drop below 2/3.If the score drops below 3 try switching gnomes, if the score is not better stick with the first choice.After choosing a gnome you have approx 1 second until needing to click the spacebar, this will maximise points if you are quick.Relax and focus on the rhythm of choosing the gnome and clicking space bar for the basket.Good luck and enjoy.
